blocks.html:
The property label data model.
Stores custom display labels for entity properties.
Labels are global (shared across all admin users).

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the property label.

types.name: entity
types.description: The entity this label applies to (e.g., "Order", "Product").

types.name: label
types.description: Custom display name for the property.

types.name: description
types.description: Optional description providing context about the property.

types.name: created_at
types.description: The date the label was created.

types.name: updated_at
types.description: The date the label was last updated.
